snippet.title: RENSE - Official Trailer - Roguelite FPS
snippet.description:
RENSE is a fast roguelite FPS. Drop in with one gun and one melee weapon, build your run from level-up cards and chest items, and fight across terrain that's generated fresh every run while the enemies get stronger by the minute.
Free demo on Steam now, full game out 10 November.
